verdict: NEGATIVE. Head fails Urban1k (i2t 0.034 vs CLIP-B/32 0.550).
mechanism: Not text length, not mean shift. All 1,000 items share one inventory (street, buildings, cars, people, signs): txt anisotropy 0.667 means the head maps every urban caption to nearly the same vector. The head reads inventory; when inventory is constant across the pool, it has nothing left to discriminate. Urban1k is within-category fine-grained discrimination, i.e., the published out-of-scope regime, not a long-query benchmark for this head.
